notes.title: Roster has doubled!
notes.content:
[h1]Even more streamers to battle as![/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690538/c21bfa8b9b80de9ecf327cc393fd8a3ab0879011.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I may have been quiet, but definitely have been busy the last several weeks! Not only have I been working hard at trying to get Steam authentication working so that I can open the game up to a larger play test here on Steam, but we've also more than doubled the roster of streamers that will eventually be featured in the game!

There are now over 90 streamers who have we are collaborating with to be featured in this game! I've been working behind the scenes to get them game ready, several of which are already in and tested in the game and look amazing![/p][p][/p][p]The list below is just a portion of the streamers featured in the game, with more that have been confirmed since I last made this image. More details about them to come![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://imgproxy.fourthwall.com/hA3dSTdT-TR9ZvnFois7MUBt6wlqqgwhotq3PK6kPWw/w:1400/sm:1/enc/vPNBMWGV65g-adfO/Kgk6qHpF2ugJ9gvm/zBRJlyIC_C1_yqW_/cInxTwc4GeJlFLA6/ED_TUvHka-vMqElG/Y_4C3vc5yfCFvNsh/5qsawUMEr8qadCId/V46xQA083qgR3-9l/FG1kHqdStX6tIhhZ/2nPFCfbdhkn5h1ZS/u8l4tHlc-L38xKH1/QdqdN_mVVe0G6Nd1/HcwM5weEanblQFIg/Abo5OUTVKWa7HJrs/5kEjQzwk0ol757sb/ZUC4zfGqE-11PaUT"][/img][/p][p]PS: We're launching a Kickstarter soon to help raise funds so I can hire a team to help me take this game to the next level (for those of you who don't know, I've mostly been developing this game by myself, though lately I've been getting some incredible aid from some of the streamers featured in the game).

More news to come about that soon as well!

If you want the latest and to see progress of the game as it happens, you can always check out and follow me on Twitch, I livestream the game development at least once or twice a week: [url="https://twitch.tv/buriedcandy"]https://twitch.tv/buriedcandy[/url][/p]

notes.title: LIVE DEV: Adding Pets To The Calling
notes.content: [h2]Pets are now a thing in The Calling! [/h2][p][/p][p]As someone who started my streaming career playing Genshin Impact, there is so much inspiration from that game that I wanted to bring into The Calling. I first started off with adding in a dynamic weather system, and now I've added in the little pet companions that can accompany you into battle. [/p][p][/p][p]I'll be working on the pets system more live during my Twitch stream tonight (and stream every Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday nights) at 8pm Eastern. [/p][p][/p][p]Watch the my livestream here: [url="https://twitch.tv/buriedcandy"]https://twitch.tv/buriedcandy[/url] [/p][p]Check out The Calling Stream Team: [url="https://twitch.tv/team/thecalling"]https://twitch.tv/team/thecalling[/url][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Xb_O7UrWm_k;full"][/previewyoutube]
